requirements.statement: Verify the authorized plan-stage fixture through real native publication, exact independent Agent-instance review, Controller approval, activation, remote drift checks and confirmed cleanup.

sections.content: Controller-authorized plan.InputReader fixture only. Upstream startup, design and Planner validation are not claimed.
Publish one fixture Issue, Contract and Plan; independent Agent-instance review; exact Controller approval; activate; reread and clean up.
The committed fixture is read-only host input. The production Gateway remains the only GitHub fact and mutation boundary.
Use the existing protocol Contract, Run, Plan, PlanAcceptance and Approval shapes. Never fabricate native IDs.
The fixture is static input, not an execution ledger. Created objects and outcomes live in GitHub.
Only the explicit Controller run scope authorizes writes. The single real publisher does not prove credential separation.
Use yes8080/projectctl, existing control Issue 2 and existing Milestone 1. Never create a Milestone.
Go 1.22-compatible plan package and standard-library GitHub Gateway. No model invocation is part of this fixture.
macOS Controller host; read immutable sources from the exact published implementation head; credentials remain outside fixture data.
Strictly decode the static candidate and design DTO. Run offline regressions separately from real GitHub evidence.
The sole integration requirement covers this plan-stage boundary only. Full startup-to-delivery integration remains Issue 11.
No migration or rewriting of the existing Markdown control Issue or bootstrap records.
Ambiguous writes, drift, identity mismatch and incomplete cleanup block success; preserve immutable evidence.
A bounded run succeeds only after exact reviewed activation and verified closure of every newly-created Issue.
Never delete or edit pre-existing objects or immutable fixture comments. Close only exact newly-created Issues; report incomplete cleanup.

policy.goal: Exercise the authorized Issue 9 plan-only live boundary without claiming upstream validation

criteria: Exact plan-stage fixture is approved and activated after independent Agent-instance review
All newly-created fixture Issues are closed and closure is reread
No pre-existing object was modified; immutable evidence comments remain

environment.runtime: Controller-owned plan-only live runner; no model calls
environment.acceptance_target: yes8080/projectctl control Issue 2 and existing Milestone 1
environment.external_usage_limit: No separately metered provider use; maximum 24 comments, 3 Issues, 2 edges, 0 Milestones
